notes.title: v1.0.8 Important Update: Game Name Change!!!
notes.notes:
1、The main update this time involves renaming the game in English, changing from the previous "Super Kalavinka" to "Super Miaoyin". This modification includes all changes to the entire game's installation directory and save directory!!!

[b]​Important Notice: [/b]If you already have game saves, please follow these steps to transfer your saves to the new version:

1、Press the "WIN+R" key combination on your keyboard, or type "%LOCALAPPDATA%" (without quotes) in the search bar next to the "Start" button.
2、In the opened window, locate the "SuperKalavinka" and "SuperMiaoyin" folders. Enter the "SuperKalavinka" folder, then copy the entire "Saved" folder and paste it into the "SuperMiaoyin" folder.
3、For further questions, please consult us on Discord:
https://discord.com/channels/1372228696382898266/1372228697557307413
4、Fixed a gravity bug related to the top planet.
5、Adjusted the brightness of nighttime.

notes.title: v1.0.6 Game Update
notes.notes:
1. Optimized the issue where the lotus leaf platform descended too quickly, making the game too difficult. Now, the player will fall off the lotus leaf after standing on it for 2 seconds.
2. Optimized the jump, double jump, and dash actions and adjusted their values.
3. Optimized and adjusted multiple levels.
4. Added more sound effects.
